name: get_fact
description: Get a random cat fact. Returns the fact text and character length. Use get_facts to retrieve multiple facts at once.

name: list_breeds
description: Search cat breeds by name or list all available breeds. Returns breed name, country of origin, coat type, and pattern details.

limit.description: Number of breeds to return. Defaults to 10.

name: get_facts
description: Get multiple random cat facts at once. Specify count (e.g., 5). Returns array of fact texts with character lengths.

limit.description: Number of facts to return. Defaults to 5.
